title: CROSS+WALKRI Round Identity Sub-Schema
description: Shared identity sub-schema referenced by every cohort-specific schema in the CROSS+WALKRI family. The fields here are the join key across cohort artifacts for a single round.

round_id.description: Unique identifier for the round within the program. Stable across all cohort artifacts referencing this round.

program_id.description: The funding program this round belongs to. A program may contain multiple rounds; a round belongs to exactly one program.

funder_id.description: The funding entity operating this round. Maps to the funder side of the Funder-Side Obligation Architecture.

cycle_number.description: The numeric cycle this round occupies within the program. Increments per round; resets only on program retirement.

conforms_to.description: The CROSS+WALKRI family release-snapshot this round instance claims to satisfy. Validators enforce that all referenced schema versions match the release-snapshot manifest.
